heard: Jupiter and Saturn could survive the death of our Sun. Most people assume the whole solar system gets destroyed together. Our Sun will eventually exhaust its core hydrogen fuel. The star will expand into a massive red giant. It'll swallow inner worlds like Mercury and Venus, but outer gas giants sit far enough away to escape. The Sun will then shrink into a dense white dwarf. While the inner worlds vanish, these giants will orbit the Sun's cold corpse.
